Name: Android Chest Buttons
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Android Chest Buttons adds two simple buttons to chest menus on Stardew Valley Android:
[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]G — Grab All
Moves as much as possible from the chest into your backpack.

S — Stash All
Moves as much as possible from your backpack into the chest.

Made specifically with Android controls in mind.


FEATURES
- Grab All button
- Stash All button
- Android-friendly touch controls
- Configurable button position
- Protected backpack slots
- Default protected slots are the first 5 backpack slots
- Protected slots stay untouched when using Stash All
- Grab All fills the earliest available backpack slots after protected items
- Compatible with larger chest capacities such as Bigger Storage
- Compatible with Always Organize Chests
- Optional support for Convenient Inventory protected/favorite slots
- Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support
- Translation-ready


PROTECTED BACKPACK SLOTS
By default, backpack slots:

0,1,2,3,4

are protected from Stash All.

You can change the protected slot list through Generic Mod Config Menu.

Slot numbering starts at 0 from the top-left backpack slot and continues left to right.


CONFIGURATION
If you have Generic Mod Config Menu, you can configure:

- Horizontal button position
- Vertical button position
- Manual slot locking
- Which backpack slots are protected

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.


REQUIREMENTS
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI Android

Tested on:
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3
- Android SMAPI 4.3.2.5

COMPATIBILITY
Tested with:

- Bigger Storage Android
- Always Organize Chests
- Generic Mod Config Menu
- large-capacity chests


TRANSLATIONS
The mod supports localization.

If you'd like to contribute a translation, copy:

i18n/default.json

translate the values, and rename the file to the appropriate Stardew Valley locale code.

A TRANSLATING.txt file is included with the mod.

Translations do not require rebuilding the DLL.


CREDITS
Created by KhaStark.

The functionality was inspired by the convenience of chest grab/stash mods such as MH Chest Grabber and MH Chest Stasher, with the implementation built specifically for Android behavior and controls.[/font]
